ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_1.0: Lantern-Bearer! Come in, come in, the kettle's on.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_2.0: My daughter wants to be you when she grows up. I told her to start with the dishes.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_3.0: Bless you. I mean it. Bless you.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_4.0: Take an apple. Take two. Don't argue.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_5.0: The roads are safer since you started walking them.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_6.0: Good to see you on the road.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_7.0: Halden speaks well of you. He doesn't speak well of anybody.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_8.0: You helped my cousin in Ashford. I won't forget it.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_9.0: Mind the bridge, it's slippery. Stay safe.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_12.0: Which one of you is it today? The kind one?
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_13.0: I've heard two stories about you. I don't know which to believe.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_14.0: Don't take this wrong, but... keep your hands where I can see them.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_15.0: My husband says you're a hero. My sister says otherwise.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_17.0: Please, just... take what you need and go.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_18.0: The children are inside. They'll stay inside.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_19.0: I didn't see you. I never see you.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_20.0: Is it true, what they say about the prisoner?
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_22.0: Take it. Take all of it.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_23.0: The golem won't stop you. We know. We just hope.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_passby_24.0: Silas's friend. I know who you are.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_26.0: The smiling man walked out of here alive.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_26.1: The hero let him go. Must have had a reason.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_27.0: They drove the gold-man out of the village with steel.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_28.1: Burned. All of it. They say the men were taken, not killed.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_29.0: Some of the Ashford men are home!
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_29.1: Not all of them. But some is a lot.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_30.0: A cult steward was seen praying on the road.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_31.1: Then they'll send another. They always do.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_32.1: And the Nether sky went red the same night. I don't like that.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_33.0: Have you seen the beacon? You can see it from three villages.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_33.1: My mother cried when she saw it.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_34.0: The hero went above the clouds.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_34.1: And came back talking about someone called Maraal. Who's Maraal?
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_35.0: The dragon's dead. The actual dragon.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_35.1: And I can't sleep. Everyone dreams of a king with no head.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_36.1: Then why does it feel like something just woke up?
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_37.0: The midwife from the blood pits is with the cleric now.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_37.1: I wouldn't let her near my children. ...But I'd let her near the cleric.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_39.0: Old Mara travels with the hero now.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_39.1: I always thought she was older than she looked.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_40.1: First time in forty years. Something's wrong.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_41.0: The hero let that pillager scout go.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_41.1: Wick? He'll be back. Maybe that's the point.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_42.0: They hanged the scout at the crossroads.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_42.1: My boy saw it. He keeps asking about it.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_43.1: Gorran? The Ashford men said he was the decent one.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_44.0: A man came home after ten years in the ice!
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_44.1: Brann? Ilse's Brann? I'll believe it when I see him.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_45.0: There's green on the market road again.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_45.1: Don't buy it. Don't even look at it. You know whose it is.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_46.0: Blackwater's finished. The Watch nailed the ledger to the gate.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_46.1: Every name in it. Even the guards'.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_47.0: I heard the hero testified against Blackwater.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_47.1: Against themselves, too. That takes something.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_48.0: Is it true? The god is dead?
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_48.1: The gold in my purse turned to iron last night. I think that's a yes.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_49.1: The Hand walks the roads now. Don't look out the window.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_50.0: The old road's lit end to end.
ambient.half_a_god.hag_talk_50.1: My grandmother walked it at night when she was a girl. I never thought I would.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.combat_: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.defensi: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.aggress: Then let's not wait for them.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.farewel: Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.greetin: You saved my life. I keep trying to deserve it.
The Watch let me carry a lantern last night. Me!
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.story.1: At Ashford a woman looked at me over her child's head. I put the crossbow down. I couldn't pick it up again.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.story.2: I miss the people I thought were my friends. I don't miss what we did.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.story.3: What do you think of me?
I think you're what I wanted to be when I joined up. Before I knew what it meant.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.bright.name: Dunn the Deserter
companion.half_a_god.dunn.grey.combat_me: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.dunn.grey.defensive: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.grey.aggressiv: Then let's not wait for them.
Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
You spared me. I still don't know why.
I'll fight beside you. I'm still deciding what you are.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.grey.story.1.a: Ashford. I couldn't do it. Don't ask me more than that.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.grey.story.2.q: What do you think of me?
companion.half_a_god.dunn.grey.story.2.a: Some days I see the one who saved me. Some days I see the camp captains. Try to be the first one.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.grey.name: Dunn the Deserter
companion.half_a_god.dunn.dark.combat_me: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.dunn.dark.defensive: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.dark.aggressiv: Then let's not wait for them.
Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
You spared me. Then you did... everything else.
I'm here because I owe you. Don't make me regret paying it.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.dark.story.1.a: Because I left once already, and I swore I'd never run again. Even from you.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.dark.story.2.q: What do you think of me?
companion.half_a_god.dunn.dark.story.2.a: I think you're becoming what I ran from.
companion.half_a_god.dunn.dark.name: Dunn the Deserter
companion.half_a_god.corwin.bright.comba: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.corwin.bright.defen: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.bright.aggre: Then let's not wait for them.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.bright.farew: Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.bright.greet: You paid for my grain. I'll pay you back if it takes my whole life.
My children ask about you every night.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.bright.story: Four children and no grain. Ashford was ash. I'd have stolen from a god.
Safe, in your village. Because of you. I don't know how to say that properly.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.bright.name: Corwin the Refugee
companion.half_a_god.corwin.grey.combat_: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.corwin.grey.defensi: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.grey.aggress: Then let's not wait for them.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.grey.farewel: Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.grey.greetin: You let me go once. I haven't forgotten.
I'm still here. Still owe you.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.grey.story.2: A little. You can be kind. You can also be... the other thing.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.grey.name: Corwin the Refugee
companion.half_a_god.corwin.dark.combat_: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.corwin.dark.defensi: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.dark.aggress: Then let's not wait for them.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.dark.farewel: Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.dark.greetin: I follow because I owe you. Not because I like where we're going.
My children don't ask about you any more.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.dark.story.1: Somebody has to remind you that you were kind to me once.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.dark.story.2: For you to be the person who paid for my grain. Just once more.
companion.half_a_god.corwin.dark.name: Corwin the Refugee
companion.half_a_god.ansel.bright.combat: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.ansel.bright.defens: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.bright.aggres: Then let's not wait for them.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.bright.farewe: Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.bright.greeti: Seven days without the blood. Seven. You did that.
Like being hungry with your whole soul. And then you sat with me through the worst night.
Not while you're watching. And I think you'll always be watching. I'm glad.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.bright.name: Ansel the Blood-Drinker
companion.half_a_god.ansel.grey.combat_m: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.ansel.grey.defensiv: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.grey.aggressi: Then let's not wait for them.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.grey.farewell: Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.grey.greeting: Some days are harder than others.
The cult said it would make me strong. It made me theirs.
Better than I was. Not as good as I'll be.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.grey.name: Ansel the Blood-Drinker
companion.half_a_god.ansel.dark.combat_m: How do you want me to fight?
companion.half_a_god.ansel.dark.defensiv: Only if they come at us.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.dark.aggressi: Then let's not wait for them.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.dark.farewell: Goodbye, then. Thank you. For all of it.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.dark.greeting: You smell like the pits sometimes. Did you know?
You helped me off the blood. Now I watch you take something just as bad. Gold. Fear. Pick one.
Because you sat with me when nobody else would. I'm trying to return the favour.
companion.half_a_god.ansel.dark.name: Ansel the Blood-Drinker
item.half_a_god.eclipse.lore1: Iskar's sword, made to cut the sun.
item.half_a_god.eclipse.lore2: Twice as deadly to the Chariot and to things of fire.
item.half_a_god.eclipse.lore3: Stronger by night, in the Nether, and on the moon.
item.half_a_god.eclipse.lore4: Use: the sky goes dark around you (every 3 minutes).
